scanNote:
3-UNITNING BESHINCHI BETI (22-bet).

Yuqorida chapda binafsha-ko'k yorliqda oq '3' va yonida 'Shop till you Drop!'

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Making Comparisons' sarlavhasi.
21) 'Complete the table, then say how we form the comparative and superlative forms of adjectives.' Och yashil ramkali jadval: chap ustunda sifatlar (big, short, beautiful, large, expensive, long, bad, good, little), o'rtada 'Comparative', o'ngda 'Superlative'. Ba'zi katakchalar TO'LDIRILGAN (the biggest, the shortest, the most beautiful, the largest, more expensive than, worse than, the best, the least), qolganlari BO'Sh.
22) 'In pairs, use the following expressions to compare the things in the pictures, as in the example.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: much cheaper, the most expensive, less expensive, not as nice as, longer than, the shortest, the same price as, shorter than, not as long as, much more beautiful.
Ostida CHIZMA RASM: to'rtta shlyapa (ko'k £7, yashil £20, qizil £100, sariq £20) va to'rtta yubka (qizil £40, kulrang £35, jigarrang £40, binafsha £20). Har birining narxi oq oval yorliqda.
Ostida ko'k qiya namuna: 'The purple skirt is much cheaper than the brown skirt.' ('much cheaper' tagiga chizilgan)
23) 'Explain the words in the list. Which of them can we use with a pair of?' 21 ta kiyim nomi qiya harflarda.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Communication a) Asking about Prices' sarlavhasi.
24) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen to the dialogue, then act out similar dialogues in pairs, using words from Ex. 23.' A va B dialogi; 'this pair of boots' va "These boots? They're 60 funt" QIYA harflarda.

O'NG USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'b) Polite Requests and Offers' sarlavhasi.
25) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Complete the dialogues with the sentences in the list, then listen and check. In which shops could you hear these dialogues?' To'rtta gap qiya harflarda. Ostida ikkita YIRTILGAN QOG'OZ shaklidagi dialog (1 - och sariq, 2 - och yashil), bo'sh nuqtali joylar bilan.
26) a) 'Name the shops in the pictures and say what you can buy in each.' b) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen and match the dialogues to the shops in the pictures.'
Ostida BESh SURAT (A - E), har birida oq yorliq va bo'sh katakcha:
• A - kiyim do'koni: ikki ayol javondagi kiyimlarni ko'rmoqda
• B - supermarket: aravachada bola bilan turgan erkak, javonlarda mahsulotlar
• C - novvoyxona: fartukdagi ayol vitrina orqasida non uzatmoqda, oldida erkak
• D - meva-sabzavot do'koni: oq ko'ylakdagi sotuvchi mijozga meva uzatmoqda
• E - kitob do'koni: ayol javonlar orasida kitob o'qimoqda
   c) 'In pairs, choose two of the shops in the pictures and act out a suitable dialogue for each shop.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '22'.

exercises.instructionEn: Comparative and superlative forms of adjectives.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlarning qiyosiy va eng yuqori darajasi.
exercises.explanationUz:
SIFATNING UCh DARAJASI.

  1) ODDIY (positive):    big
  2) QIYoSIY (comparative): biggER THAN
  3) ENG YUQORI (superlative):
     THE biggEST


QANDAY YaSALADI - UZUNLIGIGA QARAB:

  QISQA SIFATLAR (bir bo'g'inli va
  ba'zi ikki bo'g'inli):
     + -ER / THE + -EST

     short  → shorter  → the shortest
     long   → longer   → the longest
     cheap  → cheaper  → the cheapest

  UZUN SIFATLAR (ikki va undan ko'p
  bo'g'inli):
     MORE + sifat / THE MOST + sifat

     expensive → more expensive →
        the most expensive
     beautiful → more beautiful →
        the most beautiful


⚠ IMLO QOIDALARI (qisqa sifatlar):

  1) 'E' bilan tugasa - faqat -R/-ST:
     large → larger → the largest
     nice  → nicer  → the nicest

  2) QISQA UNLI + BITTA UNDOSh →
     UNDOSh IKKILANADI:
     big → biGGer → the biGGest
     hot → hoTTer → the hoTTest
     thin → thiNNer → the thiNNest

  3) UNDOSh + Y → -IER/-IEST:
     easy → easier → the easiest
     happy → happier → the happiest
     trendy → trendier → the trendiest


⚠ QOIDASIZ ShAKLLAR - YoDLASh ShART:

  good   → better  → the best
  bad    → worse   → the worst
  little → less    → the least
  much/many → more → the most
  far    → further/farther →
           the furthest/farthest

  ⚠ Jadvalda 'good', 'bad', 'little'
  aynan shu qoidasizlar.


⚠ 'THAN' va 'THE':

  QIYoSIYda 'THAN':
     'cheaper THAN the brown skirt'
  ENG YUQORIda 'THE':
     'THE cheapest skirt'

  ⚠ 'more cheaper' - XATO (ikki marta
  qiyoslash).
  ⚠ 'the most cheapest' - XATO.


⚠ KUChAYTIRUVChI SO'ZLAR:

  MUCH cheaper = ancha arzonroq
  FAR more expensive = ancha qimmatroq
  A LOT bigger = ancha kattaroq
  A BIT longer = biroz uzunroq

  ⚠ 'VERY cheaper' - XATO!
  'very' faqat ODDIY sifat bilan.


⚠ TENGLIK VA TENGSIZLIK:

  AS ... AS = ... dek
     'as nice as' = shunchalik chiroyli
  NOT AS ... AS = ... dek emas
     'not as long as' = shunchalik uzun
     emas
  THE SAME ... AS = bir xil
     'the same price as' = bir xil narxda

  ⚠ 22-mashqdagi ro'yxatda uchalasi
  ham bor.


⚠ 'LESS' - QIYoSIYNING AKSI:

  'less expensive' = kamroq qimmat
  = 'cheaper' bilan bir xil ma'no,
  lekin muloyimroq.

points.en: Short adjectives: short - shorter than - the shortest
points.uz: Qisqa sifatlar: kalta - kaltaroq - eng kalta
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bir bo'g'inli sifatlarga -ER va -EST
qo'shiladi.
⚠ Qiyosiyda 'THAN', eng yuqorida 'THE'.

points.en: Long adjectives: expensive - more expensive than - the most expensive
points.uz: Uzun sifatlar: qimmat - qimmatroq - eng qimmat
points.noteUz:
⚠ Ikki va undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar
'more' va 'the most' bilan.
⚠ 'expensiver' - XATO.

points.en: big - bigger than - the biggest (the consonant doubles)
points.noteUz:
⚠ QISQA UNLI + BITTA UNDOSh → undosh
IKKILANADI: biG → biGGer.
⚠ Yana: hot → hotter, thin → thinner.

points.en: large - larger than - the largest (only -r/-st after 'e')
points.uz: katta - kattaroq - eng katta ('e' dan keyin faqat -r/-st)

points.noteUz:
⚠ QOIDASIZ shakl - yodlash ShART.
⚠ 'gooder' yoki 'more good' - XATO.

⚠ QOIDASIZ shakl.
⚠ 'worse' va 'worst' talaffuzi juda yaqin:
/wɜːs/ va /wɜːst/.

points.en: as ... as / not as ... as / the same ... as
points.uz: ... dek / ... dek emas / ... bilan bir xil
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'as nice AS', 'not as long AS',
'the same price AS'.
⚠ Uchalasida ham OXIRIDA 'AS'.

points.en: much cheaper, far more expensive, a bit longer
points.uz: ancha arzonroq, ancha qimmatroq, biroz uzunroq
points.noteUz:
⚠ Qiyosiy darajani KUChAYTIRUVChI so'zlar.
⚠ 'VERY cheaper' - XATO! 'very' faqat oddiy
sifat bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the table, then say how we form the comparative and superlative forms of adjectives.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni to'ldiring, so'ng sifatlarning qiyosiy va eng yuqori darajasi qanday yasalishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  big       biggER THAN      THE biggEST
  short     shortER THAN     THE shortEST
  beautiful MORE beautiful   THE MOST
            THAN             beautiful
  large     largER THAN      THE largEST
  expensive MORE expensive   THE MOST
            THAN             expensive
  long      longER THAN      THE longEST
  bad       WORSE THAN       THE WORST
  good      BETTER THAN      THE BEST
  little    LESS THAN        THE LEAST


⚠ JADVALDAN KO'RINADIGAN QOIDA:

  QISQA (big, short, large, long) →
     -ER / -EST
  UZUN (beautiful, expensive) →
     more / the most
  QOIDASIZ (bad, good, little) →
     yodlash ShART


⚠ IMLOGA DIQQAT:

  big   → biGGer  (undosh ikkilanadi)
  large → largEr  (faqat -r, 'e' bor)
  short → shorter (oddiy)
  long  → longer  (oddiy)

  ⚠ 'long' da 'g' IKKILANMAYDI, chunki
  'ng' - bitta tovush.

items.whyUz: ⚠ QISQA UNLI + BITTA UNDOSh → undosh IKKILANADI.

⚠ Qiyosiy shakli KITOBDA BERILGAN.
⚠ UCh bo'g'inli - 'the most' bilan.

⚠ Qiyosiy shakli KITOBDA BERILGAN.
⚠ QOIDASIZ: bad - worse - the worst.

⚠ Eng yuqori shakli KITOBDA BERILGAN.
⚠ QOIDASIZ: good - better - the best.

⚠ Eng yuqori shakli KITOBDA BERILGAN.
⚠ QOIDASIZ: little - less - the least.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the following expressions to compare the things in the pictures, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda quyidagi iboralar bilan rasmdagi narsalarni qiyoslang, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDAGI NARXLAR:

  ShLYaPALAR:
     ko'k    - 7 funt
     yashil  - 20 funt
     qizil   - 100 funt
     sariq   - 20 funt

  YUBKALAR:
     qizil     - 40 funt
     kulrang   - 35 funt
     jigarrang - 40 funt
     binafsha  - 20 funt


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'The purple skirt is MUCH CHEAPER
   than the brown skirt.'
  (20 funt va 40 funt)


RO'YXATDAGI IBORALAR:

  much cheaper - ancha arzonroq
  the most expensive - eng qimmat
  less expensive - kamroq qimmat
  not as nice as - ... dek chiroyli emas
  longer than - ... dan uzunroq
  the shortest - eng kalta
  the same price as - ... bilan bir xil
     narxda
  shorter than - ... dan kaltaroq
  not as long as - ... dek uzun emas
  much more beautiful - ancha chiroyliroq


⚠ QAYSI IBORA QAYSI JUFTLIK UChUN:

  the most expensive → qizil shlyapa
     (100 funt - hammadan qimmat)
  the same price as → yashil va sariq
     shlyapa (ikkalasi 20 funt);
     qizil va jigarrang yubka (40 funt)
  much cheaper → ko'k shlyapa (7 funt)
     va qizil shlyapa (100 funt)
  the shortest → jigarrang yubka
     (rasmda eng kalta)


⚠ 'THE SAME ... AS':

  'The green hat is THE SAME PRICE AS
   the yellow hat.'
  ⚠ 'the same price WITH' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'THE' ham ShART.


⚠ 'NOT AS ... AS':

  'The blue hat is NOT AS NICE AS the
   red hat.'
  ⚠ Ikki 'as' orasida ODDIY sifat
  turadi ('nicer' EMAS).


⚠ PUL BIRLIGI:

  £ = a pound (funt sterling)
  ⚠ '£20' - 'twenty pounds' deb
  o'qiladi, lekin YoZUVDA belgi
  RAQAMDAN OLDIN turadi.
exercises.exampleEn: The purple skirt is much cheaper than the brown skirt.
exercises.exampleUz: Binafsha yubka jigarrang yubkadan ancha arzonroq.
modelAnswers: The purple skirt is much cheaper than the brown skirt.
The red hat is the most expensive of all.
The blue hat is less expensive than the green hat.
The blue hat is not as nice as the red hat.
The red skirt is longer than the brown skirt.
The brown skirt is the shortest of all.
The green hat is the same price as the yellow hat.
The grey skirt is shorter than the red skirt.
The purple skirt is not as long as the red skirt.
The red hat is much more beautiful than the blue hat.
modelAnswersUz: Binafsha yubka jigarrang yubkadan ancha arzonroq.
Ko'k shlyapa yashil shlyapadan kamroq qimmat.
Ko'k shlyapa qizil shlyapadek chiroyli emas.
Yashil shlyapa sariq shlyapa bilan bir xil narxda.
Binafsha yubka qizil yubkadek uzun emas.
Qizil shlyapa ko'k shlyapadan ancha chiroyliroq.

exercises.instructionEn: Explain the words in the list. Which of them can we use with 'a pair of'?
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni tushuntiring. Ulardan qaysilarini 'a pair of' bilan ishlatish mumkin?
exercises.explanationUz:
'A PAIR OF' QAYSI SO'ZLAR BILAN:

  ⚠ QOIDA: agar narsa IKKI QISMDAN
  iborat bo'lsa (ikki oyoq, ikki
  qo'l), u HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA turadi
  va sanash uchun 'a pair of' kerak.


'A PAIR OF' BILAN (9 ta):

  boots    - etiklar
  tights   - kolgotki
  jeans    - jinsi shim
  leggings - legginsi
  gloves   - qo'lqoplar
  shorts   - shortik
  trainers - krossovkalar
  socks    - paypoqlar
  shoes    - tuflilar

  ⚠ Bularning hammasi HAR DOIM
  KO'PLIKDA: 'a jean' - XATO,
  'jeans' to'g'ri.


'A PAIR OF' BILAN EMAS (12 ta):

  a belt      - kamar
  a tracksuit - sport kostyumi
  a cardigan  - kofta
  a tie       - galstuk
  a sweatshirt - futbolka (uzun yengli)
  a jumper    - sviter
  a coat      - palto
  a shirt     - ko'ylak
  a skirt     - yubka
  a scarf     - ro'mol
  a jacket    - kurtka, pidjak

  ⚠ Bular BITTA narsa - oddiy artikl
  bilan sanaladi.


⚠ 'TROUSERS' VA 'A TROUSER':

  'trousers' HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA -
  'a trouser' XATO.
  ⚠ 18-betda 'a pair of trousers'
  bor edi.


⚠ 'A JUMPER' - MAMLAKATGA QARAB:

  Britaniyada 'a jumper' = sviter.
  AQShda 'a sweater'.
  ⚠ AQShda 'a jumper' - butunlay boshqa
  narsa (sarafan).


⚠ 'TRAINERS' va 'SNEAKERS':

  Britaniyada 'trainers',
  AQShda 'sneakers'.


⚠ 'A SCARF' - KO'PLIGI:

  'a scarf' → 'scarVES'
  ⚠ -f/-fe → -ves: leaf/leaves,
  knife/knives, loaf/loaves.

pairs.right: a pair of ... (footwear - two of them)
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Oyoq IKKITA - shuning uchun bu so'zlar HAR
DOIM KO'PLIKDA.
⚠ 'a pair of shoes' = bir juft tufli.

⚠ Qo'l IKKITA.
⚠ Bitta qo'lqop uchun: 'a glove'.

⚠ Ikki oyoq uchun - shuning uchun HAR DOIM
KO'PLIKDA.
⚠ 'a jean' - XATO.
⚠ Xuddi shunday 'trousers' (18-betda).

pairs.left: a belt, a tie, a scarf
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Bular BITTA narsa - oddiy artikl bilan.
⚠ 'a scarf' → ko'plikda 'scarVES'.

pairs.left: a tracksuit, a cardigan, a sweatshirt, a jumper
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Britaniyada 'a jumper' = sviter;
AQShda 'a sweater'.
⚠ 'a tracksuit' - sport kostyumi (ikki qismli
bo'lsa ham BITTA to'plam).

pairs.left: a coat, a shirt, a skirt, a jacket
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Bular BITTA narsa.
⚠ 'a shirt' (ko'ylak) va 'a skirt' (yubka) -
imlosi juda o'xshash, ADAShTIRMANG!

sections.title: Communication: Asking about Prices; Polite Requests and Offers
sections.titleUz: Muloqot: Narx so'rash; Xushmuomala iltimos va takliflar

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the dialogue, then act out similar dialogues in pairs, using words from Ex. 23.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni tinglang, so'ng juftlikda 23-mashqdagi so'zlar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglarni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
NARX SO'RASh DIALOGI.


⚠ 'HOW MUCH IS ...?' va
'HOW MUCH ARE ...?':

  BIRLIK: 'How much IS this jacket?'
  KO'PLIK: 'How much ARE these boots?'

  ⚠ 'a pair of boots' - EGA 'a pair'
  (BIRLIK), shuning uchun 'How much IS
  this pair of boots?'
  ⚠ Lekin 'These boots? They'RE 60 funt' -
  'boots' ko'plik.

  ⚠ Dialogda IKKALASI ham bor - bu
  ataylab.


⚠ 'DO YOU TAKE CREDIT CARDS?':

  = kredit karta qabul qilasizmi?
  ⚠ 'to take' bu yerda = qabul qilmoq.
  ⚠ Yana: 'Do you accept credit cards?'


⚠ "I'M AFRAID NOT":

  = afsuski, yo'q.
  ⚠ To'liq: "I'm afraid we don't."
  ⚠ 18-betda ham "I'm afraid we haven't
  got any left" bor edi.


⚠ 'TO PAY CASH':

  = naqd pul bilan to'lamoq.
  ⚠ 'cash' - SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'to pay BY credit card' (predlog 'by')
  lekin 'to pay CASH' (predlogsiz) yoki
  'to pay IN cash'.


⚠ "THAT'S OKAY":

  = mayli, hechqisi yo'q.
  ⚠ 10-betdagi 27-mashqda uzr javobida
  ham shu ibora bor edi.


⚠ 'THEN' GAP OXIRIDA:

  "I'll pay cash, THEN."
  = unda naqd to'layman.
  ⚠ 'then' bu yerda 'keyin' emas,
  'unda, u holda' ma'nosida.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excuse me - how much is this pair of boots?
lines.uz: Kechirasiz, bu bir juft etik qancha turadi?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ EGA 'this pair' - BIRLIK, shuning uchun 'IS'.
⚠ 'Excuse me' - gap boshlashdan oldin.

lines.speaker: B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Bu yerda EGA 'these boots' - KO'PLIK,
shuning uchun "THEY'RE".
⚠ '£60' = 'sixty pounds'; belgi RAQAMDAN
OLDIN yoziladi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'to take' bu yerda = qabul qilmoq.
⚠ Yana: 'Do you accept credit cards?'

lines.speaker: B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ To'liq shakli: "I'm afraid we don't."
⚠ "I'm afraid" yomon xabarni YUMShATADI.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's okay. I'll pay cash, then.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'to pay cash' - predlogsiz (yoki 'in cash').
⚠ 'then' gap oxirida = 'unda, u holda'.
⚠ "I'll" - shu daqiqada qabul qilingan qaror.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the dialogues with the sentences in the list, then listen and check. In which shops could you hear these dialogues?
exercises.instructionUz: Dialoglarni ro'yxatdagi gaplar bilan to'ldiring, so'ng tinglang va tekshiring. Bu dialoglarni qaysi do'konlarda eshitish mumkin?
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXATDAGI TO'RT GAP:

  - Could I have the pills in this
    prescription, please?
  - Certainly. What would you like in it?
  - Here you are.
  - Can you deliver it?


QANDAY JOYLAShTIRILADI:

  1-DIALOG (gul do'koni):
     A: I'd like to order a bouquet of
        flowers, please.
     B: CERTAINLY. WHAT WOULD YOU LIKE
        IN IT?
     A: Roses, please, and perhaps some
        lilies. CAN YOU DELIVER IT?
     B: Yes, if it's local.

     ⚠ 'in it' = guldastaning IChIDA
     nima bo'lsin.
     ⚠ 'if it's local' = agar shu
     shaharda bo'lsa - demak
     YETKAZIB BERISh haqida gap ketyapti.

  2-DIALOG (dorixona):
     A: COULD I HAVE THE PILLS IN THIS
        PRESCRIPTION, PLEASE?
     B: Certainly. That will be £5,
        please.
     A: HERE YOU ARE.
     B: Thank you. Remember to take the
        tablets twice a day after meals.

     ⚠ 'a prescription' va 'tablets' -
     DORIXONA belgisi.
     ⚠ 'Here you are' - pul uzatilganda.


⚠ 'CERTAINLY':

  = albatta.
  ⚠ 'Of course' bilan bir xil ma'no,
  lekin RASMIYROQ - xizmat sohasida
  ko'p ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'A PRESCRIPTION':

  = shifokor retsepti.
  ⚠ 'to prescribe' = dori yozib bermoq.
  ⚠ 'p' O'QILADI: /prɪˈskrɪpʃn/.


⚠ 'PILLS' va 'TABLETS':

  Ikkalasi ham dori tabletkasi.
  ⚠ 'a pill' - dumaloq, kichik;
  'a tablet' - yassi.
  ⚠ Dialogda ikkalasi ham ishlatilgan -
  sinonim sifatida.


⚠ 'TWICE A DAY':

  = kuniga ikki marta.
  ⚠ 'once a day' - kuniga bir marta
  ⚠ 'three times a day' - kuniga uch marta
  ⚠ 'a' bu yerda = 'per' (har).


⚠ 'AFTER MEALS':

  = ovqatdan keyin.
  ⚠ 'a meal' = ovqatlanish mahali
  (7-betdagi Tailand matnida ham bor edi).


⚠ 'TO DELIVER':

  = yetkazib bermoq.
  ⚠ 21-betdagi Harrods matnida
  'a van delivery service' bor edi.

lines.speaker: 1  A
lines.en: I'd like to order a bouquet of flowers, please.
lines.uz: Bir dasta gul buyurtma qilmoqchi edim.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ "I'd like to" + fe'l - muloyim iltimos.
⚠ 'a bouquet' - fransuzcha, /buˈkeɪ/.
⚠ Bu - GUL DO'KONI (a florist's).

lines.speaker: 1  B
lines.answer: Certainly. What would you like in it?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'in IT' = guldastaning ichida - demak
oldingi gapda GULDASTA tilga olingan.
⚠ 'Certainly' - 'Of course' dan rasmiyroq.

lines.speaker: 1  A
lines.en: Roses, please, and perhaps some lilies. ___
lines.uz: Atirgul, iltimos, va balki bir nechta nilufar ham. Yetkazib bera olasizmi?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Keyingi javob 'Yes, if it's LOCAL' - demak
YETKAZIB BERISh haqida so'ralgan.
⚠ 'perhaps' = balki.

lines.speaker: 1  B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'local' = mahalliy, shu joydagi.
⚠ 'if' - shart gapi (5-unit mavzusi).

lines.speaker: 2  A
lines.answer: Could I have the pills in this prescription, please?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Keyingi javobda NARX aytilgan - demak
SOTIB OLISh haqida.
⚠ 'a prescription' - DORIXONA belgisi.
⚠ 'Could I have ...?' - muloyim iltimos
(18-betdagi 3-mashq).

lines.speaker: 2  B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'That will be ...' - narxni aytishning
muloyim shakli.
⚠ Kelasi zamon xushmuomalalik beradi.

lines.speaker: 2  A
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Pul uzatilganda aytiladi.
⚠ 10-betdagi 27-mashqda ham bor edi.

lines.speaker: 2  B
lines.en: Thank you. Remember to take the tablets twice a day after meals.
lines.uz: Rahmat. Tabletkalarni kuniga ikki marta ovqatdan keyin ichishni unutmang.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'Remember TO DO sth' = qilishni unutmang.
⚠ 'Remember DOING sth' = qilganingizni
eslang - BOShQA ma'no!
⚠ 'twice a day' = kuniga ikki marta.

exercises.audioRequiredUz: 26b da dialoglarni suratlarga moslash faqat audio bilan bajariladi; 26a (do'kon nomlari) esa suratdan aniqlanadi.
exercises.instructionEn: a) Name the shops in the pictures and say what you can buy in each. b) Listen and match the dialogues to the shops in the pictures.
exercises.instructionUz: a) Suratlardagi do'konlarni nomlang va har birida nima sotib olish mumkinligini ayting. b) Tinglang va dialoglarni suratlardagi do'konlarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh SURAT - BESh DO'KON.

  ⚠ 26a ni suratdan bajarish mumkin;
  26b uchun AUDIO kerak.

  * ⚠ Qaysi dialog qaysi do'konga
    tegishli - faqat AUDIODAN.


HAR DO'KONDA NIMA SOTILADI:

  A - a boutique / a clothes shop:
     dresses, jackets, shirts, skirts,
     trousers

  B - a supermarket:
     food, drinks, cleaning products,
     sugar, bread

  C - a baker's:
     bread, rolls, cakes, biscuits

  D - a greengrocer's:
     fruit and vegetables - apples,
     grapes, tomatoes, potatoes

  E - a bookshop:
     books, magazines, maps


⚠ 18-BETDAGI RO'YXAT BILAN BOG'LIQ:

  Bu do'kon nomlari 18-betdagi
  1-mashqda o'rganilgan edi - bu yerda
  ular QAYTA ishlatilyapti.

  ⚠ Bu - 'recycling' usuli: so'z bir
  unit ichida bir necha marta
  qaytariladi va shu bilan mustahkam
  esda qoladi.


⚠ 26c - JUFTLIKDA DIALOG:

  Ikki do'konni tanlab, har biriga mos
  dialog tuzing.

  ⚠ 18-betdagi 3-mashq, 20-betdagi
  16-mashq va shu betdagi 24, 25-mashq
  qoliplaridan foydalaning:
     'Can/Could I have ..., please?'
     'How much is/are ...?'
     'Do you take credit cards?'
     "I'm afraid we haven't got any left."

items.hintUz: Ikki ayol javondagi rangli kiyimlarni ko'rmoqda
items.whyUz:
⚠ Suratda kiyim javonlari va ikki xaridor.
⚠ Bu yerdan sotib olish mumkin: dresses,
jackets, shirts, skirts, trousers.
⚠ 'a clothes shop' ham to'g'ri.

items.hintUz: Aravachada bola bilan turgan erkak, uzun javonlar
items.whyUz:
⚠ Suratda savat ARAVAChA va uzun javon qatorlari -
faqat supermarketda bo'ladi.
⚠ Bu yerdan: food, drinks, sugar, bread.

items.hintUz: Fartukdagi ayol vitrina orqasida non uzatmoqda
items.whyUz:
⚠ Suratda non va shirinliklar vitrinasi.
⚠ Bu yerdan: bread, rolls, cakes, biscuits.
⚠ 'a bakery' ham to'g'ri (18-bet, 1-mashq).

items.hintUz: Sotuvchi mijozga meva uzatmoqda, atrofda rangli mahsulotlar
items.whyUz:
⚠ Suratda meva va sabzavot rastalari.
⚠ Bu yerdan: apples, grapes, tomatoes, potatoes.
⚠ 'green' + 'grocer' (18-bet, 1-mashq).

items.hintUz: Ayol javonlar orasida kitob o'qib turibdi
items.whyUz:
⚠ Suratda kitob javonlari.
⚠ Bu yerdan: books, magazines, maps.
⚠ 'a bookSTALL' emas - u KO'ChADA bo'ladi
(18-bet, G surati).

patterns.exampleEn: The purple skirt is much cheaper than the brown skirt.
patterns.exampleUz: Binafsha yubka jigarrang yubkadan ancha arzonroq.

patterns.exampleEn: The red hat is the most expensive of all.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Eng yuqori darajada 'THE' ShART.
⚠ Uzun sifat uchun 'the most'.

patterns.formula: [A] is (not) as [sifat] as [B]. / [A] is the same price as [B].
patterns.exampleEn: The blue hat is not as nice as the red hat.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'k shlyapa qizil shlyapadek chiroyli emas.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ikki 'as' orasida ODDIY sifat turadi.
⚠ 'the same ... AS' - 'with' EMAS.

patterns.exampleEn: How much is this pair of boots? - They're £60.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu bir juft etik qancha? - 60 funt.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'a pair' - BIRLIK, shuning uchun 'IS'.
⚠ 'boots' - KO'PLIK, shuning uchun "they're".

patterns.exampleEn: Could I have the pills in this prescription, please? - Certainly.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'Could' - muloyim iltimos.
⚠ 'Certainly' - xizmat sohasidagi rasmiy javob.

patterns.exampleEn: Remember to take the tablets twice a day after meals.
patterns.exampleUz: Tabletkalarni kuniga ikki marta ovqatdan keyin ichishni unutmang.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'Remember TO DO' = qilishni unutmang.
⚠ 'Remember DOING' = qilganingizni eslang -
BOShQA ma'no!

groups.explanationUz: Bu uchtasini YoDLASh ShART - qoida yo'q.
Ikki qismdan iborat kiyim va oyoq kiyimi. Sanash uchun 'a pair of' kerak.
